camel_example: aliyun sas DescribePropertySoftwareDetail --region cn-hangzhou --Path '/etc/test' --InstallTimeEnd 1650012695000 --SoftwareVersion '3.10.0' --Uuid '50d213b4-3a35-427a-b8a5-0000' --PageSize 10 --NextToken E17B501887A2D3AA5E8360A6EFA3B000 --CurrentPage 1 --InstallTimeStart 1649321495000 --Extend 1 --UseNextToken true --Remark '192.168.XX.XX' --Name kernel
description_en: Query details of asset fingerprint software collection
description_zh: 获取软件列表中一个软件的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-property-software-detail --remark 192.168.XX.XX --name kernel --path /etc/test --software-version 3.10.0 --uuid 50d213b4-3a35-427a-b8a5-0000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --install-time-start 1649321495000 --install-time-end 1650012695000 --extend 1 --use-next-token true --next-token E17B501887A2D3AA5E8360A6EFA3B000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePropertySoftwareDetail

parameters.help_en: The name or IP address of the server to be queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的服务器的名称或IP地址
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The name of the software to be queried
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The installation path of the software
parameters.name: path

parameters.help_en: The version information of the software
parameters.name: software_version

parameters.help_en: Set which page of the returned results to start displaying the query results. The default value is 1, indicating that the display starts from the first page
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: Set the number of software asset fingerprint information items displayed per page during pagination. The default value is 10, indicating that 10 items of software asset fingerprint information are displayed per page
parameters.help_zh: 设置分页查询时，每页显示的软件资产的指纹信息的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条软件资产的指纹信息
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The timestamp when the software update started. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 软件更新开始的时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: install_time_start

parameters.help_en: The timestamp when the software update ended. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 软件更新结束的时间戳。单位为毫秒
parameters.name: install_time_end

parameters.help_en: Whether the software name supports fuzzy search. To enable fuzzy search, set the value of this parameter to 1; other values or an empty value indicate that fuzzy search is not supported
parameters.help_zh: 软件名称是否支持模糊查询。要设置支持模糊查询时，请将该参数的取值设置为1，其他值或取值为空则表示不支持模糊查询
parameters.name: extend

parameters.help_en:
Whether to use the NextToken method to pull asset list data. If this parameter is used, TotalCount will no longer be returned. Values:

true: Use the NextToken method.
false: Do not use the NextToken method
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用NextToken方式拉取资产列表数据。如果使用此参数TotalCount不再返回。取值：

true：使用NextToken方式。
false：不使用NextToken方式
parameters.name: use_next_token

parameters.help_en:
Used to mark the starting position for reading. Leave it blank to start from the beginning.

For the first call, you do not need to fill this in; the response will include the NextToken for the second call, and each subsequent call's response will contain the NextToken for the next call
parameters.help_zh:
用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始。

第一次调用不用填写，会在返回结果中包含第二次调用时用的NextToken，之后每次调用返回结果中都有下一次调用时的NextToken
parameters.name: next_token
